what_this_is: A jacketed constant-volume stirred tank running one irreversible exothermic first-order liquid-phase reaction, written the way a process notebook writes it.
why_these_numbers: The plant is the textbook 100 L / 100 L-per-min propylene-glycol-style reactor: an aqueous feed, a 50 kJ/mol exotherm and a jacket 50 K below the feed. The initial state is deliberately away from any steady state - colder and richer than the feed - so the comparison is a genuine transient and not a marginal drift about an equilibrium.
evidence_level: LEVEL 5 - independent analytical, with the molar gas constant at LEVEL 3.

constant_rate_variant.what_this_is: The same plant read by the temperature-independent rate model. It is a different model family, not a different solver setting.

derivations_left_to_the_adapters: concentrations from mol/L to mol/m3, volumes from L to m3, energies from kJ to J, rates from per-minute to per-second
